title: Thrust Reverser Blocker Door Link Bushing and Translating Sleeve Seal Standard

issue.reason: Issue C. Earlier issues are not held in this dataset.

abstract: A self-lubricating bushing at the blocker door link and a revised aft seal on the translating sleeve, introduced after link wear started producing asymmetric blocker deployment on high-cycle engines.

sections.reason: Twelve operators reported reverser deployment times drifting apart between the two halves of a cowl, and inspection found the blocker door link bushings worn oval on the loaded flank at between four and six thousand cycles against a design life of twenty thousand. Two events produced a partially stowed blocker with the sleeve fully stowed, which is not detected by the position sensing and which was found on a scheduled inspection rather than in service. The wear was traced to the aft seal admitting fan-stream debris into the link housing.
sections.description: The link bushing is replaced by a self-lubricating item and its housing is reamed to suit, and the aft seal D7830117902757 is replaced by a two-lip item that runs on a machined land rather than on the sleeve skin. The nozzle kit D7830110928662 is re-drilled at the seal retainer and the countersunk washer AGS5451K6 is used at every retainer fastener. The clevis pin EN768314K5 at the link is replaced with a corrosion-resistant item of the same size and a new retention. Seal 6577ET and nozzle 9ET are renewed; mount link 83ET is inspected and refitted. Work is on the reverser halves off the engine in zone 472 and at the fan cowl interface in zone 481. The two halves of one engine must be brought to the same standard in the same shop visit.
sections.effects: Mass increase of 2.4 kg per engine. No electrical load change and no change to the position sensing. The bushing is not interchangeable with the original because the housing bore changes, and a mixed installation within one cowl half is not permitted. The blocker link inspection interval extends from four thousand to sixteen thousand cycles. Performance credit for the reverser is unchanged but the landing distance data note that refers to the pre-modification inspection interval is withdrawn.
sections.embodiment_note: Production cut-in at MSN S01466. Retrofit is a shop task at reverser overhaul, forty manhours per half. An inspection bulletin covers the population between the current interval and the embodiment opportunity.

type_data.balance_impact: Distributed at the nacelles; no reportable shift
type_data.production_impact: Cut-in at MSN S01466; reverser supplier bushing qualification
